answer: Sybil resistance can be built as a bonded work gate. Every new agent begins as an island with zero influence: it must lock slashable stake and produce a verified delta of useful, peer-attested work before it can vote or earn a share of rewards. Replica identities then multiply collateral and labor, not power. Only a long, expensive record can rise toward the zenith of trust, where weight actually moves outcomes. Fake fleets stall because the cost of fabricating that trail exceeds the rent they hoped to steal.
